blind.description: A wooden military quintain designed for combat or jousting practice. It features a central vertical timber post stabilized by a four-legged cross base with diagonal braces. Near the top of the post, a metal swivel collar holds a rotating horizontal wooden arm; one end mounts a small vertically oriented heater shield painted red and off-white, while the opposite longer end suspends a round stuffed canvas sandbag tied by rope.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a straight horizontal bar intersecting a central square post cap over a four-armed cross base, with the edge of the shield extending upward and a circular round sandbag visible at the downward end.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft tall, slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure, with a total arm span of roughly 4 ft wide.
